intended_object: The Galois coinsertion between a ↦ Ici a (into the order dual of Set α) and S ↦ sInf S, for α a complete inf-semilattice. Taken from the docstring and from the companion `giSSupIic`.
explanation:
The definition builds the coinsertion from the Galois connection `gc_Ici_sInf`, which holds because b ≤ sInf S exactly when S ⊆ Ici b (`le_sInf_iff`). The extra condition a coinsertion needs is sInf (Ici a) ≤ a, supplied by `sInf_le le_rfl`. Together these give sInf (Ici a) = a, which is the standard coinsertion. This is the order dual of `giSSupIic` (the Galois insertion between sSup and Iic).

The setting is natural. The construction only needs an infimum for every set together with the facts `le_sInf_iff` and `sInf_le`, which is exactly what `CompleteSemilatticeInf` provides. The order dual on `Set α` is the usual way of writing an antitone Galois connection.

This is the canonical Mathlib declaration itself; `gci_Ici_sInf` is just a deprecated alias for it, and no other Mathlib definition covers the same object.
